description: This file implements internal backend APIs for managing WAN mapping domains and rules within a COSA Data Model Library context. It includes functions for creating, initializing, and removing the WAN map objects, and handles reading/writing configuration data from/to a repository.

classes.name: PDATAMODEL_MAP
classes.description: Pointer to Data Model Map object storing WAN map data and state.

classes.name: PWAN_DML_DOMAIN_FULL2
classes.description: Pointer to WAN DML Domain structure containing list of rules and configuration.

classes.name: PWAN_DML_MAP_RULE
classes.description: Pointer to WAN DML Map Rule structure representing individual mapping rules.

classes.name: PCONTEXT_LINK_OBJECT
classes.description: Context object for managing instances within the map structure.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE WanMgr_MapCreate(VOID)
methods.description: Constructs a new WAN Map object, allocating memory and initializing function pointers.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS WanMgr_MapInitialize(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Initializes the WAN Map object, setting up repository folders, reading existing configuration, and creating domain and rule instances.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS WanMgr_MapRemove(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Removes and cleans up the WAN Map object.
